items.title: The Stars Of Gucci's 2026 Holiday Dinner in Manila
items.summary: VMAN SEA covers Gucci's November 23 holiday dinner at Uma Nota in Manila, where Filipino personalities including Anne Curtis, Marian Rivera, Jarren Garcia and Kyle Echarri wore pieces from the Core Cruise 2027 and Primavera Fall-Winter 2026 collections. Purely descriptive activation write-up, no independent evaluative verdict.

items.title: Today's Sosyalan: Gucci's intimate holiday lunch in Greenbelt
items.summary: Filipino showbiz fan account posts photos from Gucci's holiday gathering in Greenbelt, Manila, tagging attendees Anne Curtis, Bella Racelis, James Reid, Janine Gutierrez, Kylie Verzosa, Pia Jauncey, Marian Rivera and Tim Yap. Fan/society-page coverage, descriptive.

items.title: Gucci's Cruise 2027 collection marks its New York homecoming
items.summary: Manila Bulletin reports on Gucci's Cruise 2027 show staged in Times Square, New York, under Demna, framed as a brand homecoming narrative for the Filipino audience. Excluded from freshness-weighted pool reference only - retained as background context, not primary item (see note).

items.title: Billkin Served Looks At Gucci's Spring/Summer 2026 Launch At Marina Bay Sands
items.summary: Harper's Bazaar Singapore covers Thai ambassador Billkin previewing Gucci SS26 at the Marina Bay Sands boutique, the only Southeast Asian store carrying the line at the time. Descriptive activation coverage, no independent verdict; retained as regional ambassador-activity background.

items.title: Gucci's Price Cuts Expose a Bigger Problem for Luxury Fashion
items.summary: Trade analysis reports a Gucci Padlock Crystal Small Top Handle Bag fell from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450 (30 percent) between July and November, as Kering's CEO admitted prior price hikes 'went too far.' Piece links the discounting to Gucci's Q3 revenue decline of 6 percent and soft store traffic, framing premium pricing as now a liability for brands whose desirability has not kept pace.

items.title: Gucci reputation really had fallen jialat
items.summary: Long-running Singapore community thread (started Jan 2026, still active) where posters argue Gucci's heavy discounting and prevalence of easy-to-fake nylon goods are cheapening the brand into 'luxury trash tier'; one poster references a Bangkok branded-bag super sale with prices 'lower until cannot,' questioning authenticity. Thread also compares Gucci unfavorably to Balenciaga post-Demna move. Organic critical community sentiment; outside the 14-day freshness window as a single post but included because the thread remains live and representative of ongoing SEA community sentiment on brand dilution - flagged as background, not primary daily signal.

items.title: Penjualan Gucci Anjlok, Saham Induknya Ikut Terjun Bebas
items.summary: Indonesian business outlet IDN Times reports Gucci Q3 2026 revenue fell 6 percent to EUR1.291 billion, worse than the 2.8 percent analyst forecast, with direct retail/e-commerce sales down 9 percent; Kering shares plunged 10.7 percent on the news. Cites weak China/Japan demand and CEO Luca de Meo's plan to close a net 125 stores by year end. Clearly negative-earnings framing for an Indonesian SEA audience.

items.title: Ramai-Ramai Merek Mewah Mendadak Tutup Toko di China, Ada Apa?
items.summary: CNBC Indonesia reports a wave of luxury brands, Gucci among them, shutting stores across China amid weak consumer demand and a soft property market, feeding into the broader luxury-slowdown narrative that Indonesian readers track for signals about brand health. Negative/industry-crisis framing.

items.title: Fake Gucci, Ray-Ban products seized following raids on 2 HCMC downtown markets
items.summary: VnExpress International reports Vietnamese authorities raided two Ho Chi Minh City markets and seized hundreds of counterfeit Gucci and Ray-Ban items, part of a wider crackdown on fake luxury goods. Counterfeit-prevalence coverage, neutral-to-mild-negative per rubric.

items.title: NBI: Over P425M in fake luxury goods seized in Metro Manila
items.summary: Philippine Daily Inquirer reports the NBI's Intellectual Property Rights Division seized over PHP425 million in counterfeit luxury goods across Metro Manila, naming Gucci among the most frequently counterfeited brands in the Philippines. Retained as background on counterfeit exposure though outside the 14-day window; superseded in-pool by fresher VnExpress Vietnam item for the daily counterfeit signal.

items.title: BTS Jin as Gucci's global ambassador: his best looks so far
items.summary: Tatler Asia's regional roundup of BTS Jin's Gucci ambassador looks, framed positively but descriptively (what he wore, where). Activation coverage with fandom-affinity framing, capped at mild magnitude per rubric.

items.title: WTS Gucci Women GG Marmont Matese Backpack
items.summary: Malaysian community marketplace thread listing a secondhand Gucci GG Marmont backpack for resale. Transactional community volume rather than opinion; counted for community-channel buzz only, no sentiment signal.

items.title: กระเป๋าแบรนด์เนม กุชชี่ ไม่มีใบประกอบและกล่อง (Gucci bag with no receipt or box)
items.summary: Thai community forum thread where a user asks fellow members to help authenticate a Gucci bag purchased without official box or receipt, reflecting ongoing consumer anxiety about counterfeits/grey-market goods in the Thai secondhand market. Neutral-to-mild-negative per rubric (counterfeit inquiry).

items.title: Heboh Perbandingan Gaya Jin BTS & Xiao Zhan Jadi BA Gucci, Picu Perdebatan
items.summary: Indonesian entertainment outlet reports an Instagram fan controversy over perceived unequal promotional treatment between Gucci ambassadors Jin (BTS) and Xiao Zhan, including alleged doxxing by rival fan camps. Controversy is about ambassador management rather than product/brand sentiment; outside the 14-day freshness window, retained only as context - not counted toward today's primary signal set.

collection_notes: Freshness is thin for SEA on 2026-11-28: the only items clearly within the 72h-7d window are the Manila Holiday Dinner coverage (VMAN SEA, X/Twitter, Nov 23-24) and the retail-insider.com price-cut analysis (Nov 18). Several older items (idntimes Oct 29 earnings piece, CNBC Indonesia Sep 17 store-closure piece, VnExpress Nov 5 counterfeit raid, HardwareZone Jan 2026 thread, detik.com Aug 28 fan-controversy piece, Inquirer Apr 18 counterfeit seizure) were retained beyond the ideal window because same-day/same-week SEA-specific coverage was sparse outside the Manila event and price-cut story; these are flagged in their summaries and should be down-weighted by the recency decay rather than treated as fresh signal. Critical-angle searches (price hike/backlash, quality complaints, resale drop, store closures, counterfeits, 'overrated') DID surface material in SEA - mainly via Indonesian business press (idntimes, CNBC Indonesia), Vietnamese/Philippine counterfeit-raid reporting, and the Singapore HardwareZone community thread - so this pool is not purely activation coverage, but true SAME-DAY critical content was not found; closest is the Nov 18 retail-insider piece. Direct site-scoped community searches for Kaskus, Webtretho, and Reddit SEA-specific Gucci threads returned no fresh, on-topic hits; Thai/Indonesian/Vietnamese-language national dailies (Thairath, Kompas, Bangkok Post, Straits Times, CNA) returned no original same-week Gucci coverage despite targeted search. No SNS items from Instagram/TikTok/Facebook with visible engagement metrics were found and admissible (public-facing posts either lacked accessible metrics or were not genuinely SEA-market-specific).
